worker_provenance: temporary Clay research/build worker via ChatGPT GPT-5.6 Sol

frontier.question: Can immutable runtime resources be carried inside the one executable without a release sidecar while preserving explicit integrity failure semantics?

grf_candidate.hypothesis: A Linux ELF can remain directly executable with an opaque resource payload appended after the ELF image, and the runtime can recover and integrity-check that payload from /proc/self/exe without a companion file.
grf_candidate.counterhypothesis: Appending data will either break normal ELF execution or make integrity-bounded payload recovery unreliable enough to be unsuitable as an EntityOS packaging primitive.
grf_candidate.falsifier: Baseline executable, appended valid payload, and single-byte-tampered payload must produce three discriminating outcomes: missing, valid, and integrity failure.

unusual_experiment.name: ELF_APPENDED_SELF_RESOURCE_INTEGRITY_FENCE
unusual_experiment.prototype: small stripped C ELF reading /proc/self/exe; 94-byte opaque payload plus 24-byte footer; FNV-1a-64 used only as an experiment integrity discriminator, not a production cryptographic primitive

intervention.condition: same ELF plus 94-byte payload and footer

counter_probe.condition: one byte flipped in appended payload while footer expectation remained unchanged

unusual_experiment.promotion_limit: This experiment does not prove the current Python/PyInstaller EntityOS build, runtime self-containment, cryptographic authenticity, portability, or whole-machine acceptance.

architecture_delta.candidate: Allow build-time immutable Clay grammar/stdlib/manifest/media-schema resource packs to be appended inside the final ELF and accessed directly from the executable, with production-grade cryptographic digest/signature and version/provenance metadata selected separately.
architecture_delta.expected_effect: Can reduce mandatory runtime sidecars and support the one-file product boundary without requiring every embedded resource to be compiled into source constants.
architecture_delta.rollback: Do not adopt; keep PyInstaller/native resource embedding path unchanged.
architecture_delta.next_discriminator: Integrate one real canonical EntityOS resource (for example the Clay grammar) into the actual one-file build and prove byte-identical semantic behavior plus tamper fail-closed inside an isolated sandbox.
